description: Website contact finder — Finds public business contact details for a website: emails (mailto + text), phone numbers (tel links + text, E.164 when possible), social profiles (X, LinkedIn, GitHub, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and more, share buttons ignored), schema.org Organization name/address/phone, and contact forms. Scans the page plus up to 3 linked contact/about pages (deep=false to scan only the page). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_contacts
